class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleHeating
class.description: [RailVehicleHeating] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleHeating].

members.member: [code]Clima:HGeneratorEngine[/code] Type of engine driving the heating generator, when [member heating_source] is Generator. Only [constant RailVehicleEngine.MAIN] is actually supported by the simulation today.
[code]Clima:HGeneratorMinRPM[/code] Lower end of the generator's working RPM range.
[code]Clima:HGeneratorMaxRPM[/code] Upper end of the generator's working RPM range.
[code]Clima:HPowerTrans[/code] Form of energy delivered over the power cable, when [member heating_source] is PowerCable (electric or steam).
